name: Hengsheng Energy Co. Ltd. Class A
summary: Hengsheng Energy Co., Ltd engages in coal-fired thermal power business in China. The company provides steam to papermaking, textile printing and dyeing, food and dairy, home furnishing manufacturing and other enterprises in the park; and electricity to the terminal power users of the state grid. It also involved in cogeneration business; diamond business, which includes single crystal and polycrystalline diamonds; and terminal products are mainly cultured diamonds, heat sinks, and diamond blades. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Longyou Hengsheng Heating Co., Ltd. Hengsheng Energy Co., Ltd was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Quzhou, China.
